decisions.statement: The name of the file beside a page is composed here and spelled nowhere else.
A line is sorted by what it comes through, then the file, then where it is from.
Sorting the lines as text sorts them that way, so no comparison is written.
A line leaves out what it has nothing for rather than writing a null.
Two references alike are one line.
A page nothing references composes an empty body rather than a blank line.
A line that will not parse is left out rather than thrown over.
Nothing here reads a file or writes one.

definition: the file beside a page saying what references that page, composed and read
